# Abstract {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This dynamic and reproducible tutorial is part of a broader research initiative on applying ANOVA in crossover trials within the context of randomized clinical trials related to physiotherapy and rehabilitation [@georgeto2024a; @georgeto2024b; @rogers2024d]. The primary goal is to provide a comprehensive application tutorial in the R environment, demonstrating best practices for analyzing crossover designs using analysis of variance techniques.

This project adopts open science principles and reproducible research practices as outlined by @limongi2025a, @limongi2025b, and @rogers2025, ensuring transparency, accessibility, and replicability of all analyses and results. The tutorial integrates theoretical foundations with practical implementation, offering researchers and practitioners a hands-on guide for conducting rigorous statistical analyses in crossover clinical trials.

**Keywords:** Quantitative Methods, ANOVA, Crossover Trials, Crossover ANOVA, Reproducible Research, Open Science.

**How to cite this project?**

Georgeto, S. M., & Rogers, P. (2024). Applying ANOVA in Crossover Trials. https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/3RXF2
